title: This warmer takes too long to get to a decent warm temperature...
text:
This warmer takes too long to get to a decent warm temperature.... Simply put, this warmer is not good. But in reading other reviews, and seeing how others are supposedly happy with it. I decided to give it one more chance this morning! I started my day with my usual hot cup of coffee, and I purposely didn't drink it all so that I could test the leftover cold coffee one more time on this warmer! I plugged the thing in, and let it sit on P2. Every hr. I would take a sip, and nothing changed, or you can say it was luke warm. In the 4th hour, you can say it was warm. Basically, this thing takes forever to warm up. This is my scale to better articulate what I'm saying:

10 - This is off the boiler hot, cannot sip.
8 - Still very hot, but you can manage little sips without burning yourself.
6 - No longer very hot, simply hot, and you can take big sips or gulps.
4 - No longer hot, but warm
2 - Barely warm, more like lukewarm.

In the first 2hrs of using this warmer, your coffee will be a #2 on my scale above. It does absolutely nothing to your coffee. In the 3rd or 4th hour, you may get to #4, and that's being generous. I feel there should be a #3 in my scale to explain this warmer. LOL! This warmer is just not practical because it takes eternity. If you want a warmer that can reach to #6 on my scale in about 30 minutes, check out the IWOXS version. It currently shows unavailable, but when available, you should get the IWOXS, and thank me later: https://www.amazon.com/review/R11A7OF8YQYR6C/ref=cm_cr_srp_d_rdp_perm?ie=UTF8&ASIN=B08CXD4LHL

As a matter of fact, to do this testing, I used the thin white mug that came with my IWOXS set. And it still took 4 hrs. Your mug at home is most likely thicker than the mug I used for this testing, so you can just forget about it. It will probably take you 8 hrs. I would be embarrassed to give this as a gift. Both this warmer and the IWOXS warmer are Vine items. I have no dog in this fight. Just my honest opinion. Don't buy this.
